Match your book before checking answers

The original full-volume Arbeitsbuch A1 is listed by Klett with ISBN 978-3-12-606130-8. An A1.1 or A1.2 combined book also contains coursebook material, so check the section heading as well as the cover. Netzwerk neu uses a different workbook title, Übungsbuch.

Use the answer key effectively

  1. Finish a short set independently

    Complete one exercise, then mark the gaps you are unsure about before opening the key. This preserves the difference between what you knew and what you recognised after seeing an answer.

  2. Record the whole correction

    For an A1 gap, copy your corrected sentence into a personal notebook with its article or pronoun. Record an umlaut or capital letter when it changes the written form. A list of isolated answer letters rarely explains the mistake.

  3. Test the correction in a new sentence

    After checking a basic verb or noun phrase, make one sentence about your own routine. Return to the original exercise later without the PDF. This tests recall rather than the ability to copy a visible answer.

If the answers do not match

A missing chapter 8 is usually a file-selection issue: open the Kapitel 7–12 key. If the chapter is present but the exercise letters differ, compare the exact edition and make sure you did not use the Kursbuch key. Do not merge the two workbook PDFs and assume their numbering continues automatically.

Check the Kursbuch guide · Compare the Netzwerk neu edition. The same level or chapter number does not make these keys interchangeable.

Common questions

Which file should I use for chapter 6?

Use the A1.1 Arbeitsbuch file labelled Kapitel 1–6. Chapter 7 starts the A1.2 file. Match the exercise heading before checking an answer.

Can I use a coursebook answer for a workbook task?

Not reliably. Both components can contain the same chapter number, but their exercises and answer sequences are separate. Choose Arbeitsbuch for workbook tasks.
